topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces herself, frames the course of lectures on cancer biology, and outlines the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Framework of Cancer Causation: Genetics, Environment, and Epidemiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how intrinsic cellular errors, inherited genetic risk, and environmental exposures contribute to cancer development as demonstrated by epidemiological and migrant studies.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Carcinogenic Agents and Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how specific biological, physical, and chemical agents drive cancer via direct mutagenesis, xenobiotic metabolism, promotional chronic inflammation, and tissue-specific susceptibility.

topics.label: Methods for Determining and Appraising Carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the experimental and observational methodologies used to detect and prove carcinogen exposure and cancer risk.
